 Thailand head coach Anthony Hudson and Supachok Sarachat attend a pre-match press conference. (Photo supplied) 
 Head coach Anthony Hudson insisted Thailand will not take Brunei lightly as the War Elephants aim to deliver a strong performance in their opening match of the 52nd King's Cup football tournament in Sri Sa Ket on Saturday.
